title: Order Stuck in 'open'
description: An order has been in 'open' status longer than expected and has not filled or failed.

steps.label: Check if the market is currently open
steps.description: Verify that the relevant exchange is in trading hours. Many orders remain open simply because the market is closed.
steps.hint: Use the instruments endpoint to check trading hours for this ISIN.

steps.label: Check if the ISIN is halted
steps.description: Some instruments may have trading halts. Check the instrument status for halt indicators.
steps.hint: Test with sandbox ISINs: XF0000000046 (buy halt), XF0000000053 (sell halt), XF0000000061 (both halt).

steps.label: Verify position limits
steps.description: Check if the space has reached its position limits for this instrument.
steps.hint: Position limits are configured per space in the lemon.markets dashboard.

title: Trade Execution Failed
description: A trade has failed to execute. This may be due to insufficient funds, invalid ISIN, or market conditions.

steps.label: Review the failed order details
steps.description: Check the order's response payload for the failure reason code.
steps.hint: Common codes: insufficient_funds, invalid_isin, market_closed, limit_reached.

steps.label: Verify the account has sufficient funds
steps.description: Check the space's cash balance to ensure enough funds are available for the trade.

steps.label: Validate the ISIN is tradeable
steps.description: Confirm the ISIN is a valid, tradeable instrument through the instruments endpoint.

title: Client Onboarding Incomplete
description: A client space has not completed the KYC/documentation process.

steps.label: Review which documents are pending
steps.description: Check the documents endpoint for this space to see which KYC documents are still pending or rejected.
steps.hint: Common requirements: ID front/back, proof of address, tax declaration.

steps.label: Review rejection reasons
steps.description: If documents were rejected, check the rejection reason to guide the client on resubmission.
steps.hint: Common reasons: image_unreadable, document_expired, name_mismatch, address_mismatch.

steps.label: Guide the client on resubmission
steps.description: Provide clear guidance on what needs to be corrected and resubmitted.
steps.hint: Clients can re-upload documents through the onboarding flow.

title: KYC Document Rejected
description: A client's KYC document has been rejected and needs attention.

steps.label: Review the rejection reason
steps.description: Check the document's reject_reason field to understand why it was rejected.

steps.label: Communicate with the client
steps.description: Inform the client about what needs to be corrected and how to resubmit.
steps.hint: Be specific about what's wrong. 'Image too dark' vs. 'Document expired' require different actions.
